event_edition_covered: 14th Cement Expo, co-located with 9th/10th Indian Cement Review Conference (source PDF captions are internally inconsistent - see README)
organizer: ASAPP Info Global Services Pvt. Ltd. (publisher of Indian Cement Review)
source_note: This exhibitor+booth-number table is not a standalone exhibitor-list PDF. It is reproduced inside the promotional brochure for the NEXT (15th, Nov 2025) edition, in a 'GLIMPSES OF THE PAST' retrospective section. No standalone exhibitor list for the 14th edition, nor any exhibitor list for the 15th (2025) or upcoming 16th (Dec 2026, Greater Noida) edition, was found on the official site.
method: curl-fetched the official brochure PDF from cementexpo.in, extracted text with pdftotext -layout, and manually transcribed the two-column 'Exhibitors / Company names / booth no' + 'Partners' table verbatim.

origin_flag_legend.FOREIGN: The country name itself appears directly in the exhibitor's listed name in the source table (e.g. 'Pentol Germany').
origin_flag_legend.FOREIGN-PARENT: India-registered entity (Pvt Ltd / India in the name) whose ultimate corporate parent's foreign headquarters was independently confirmed via web search against the parent company's own site or a company-registry-grade source (not stated in the source PDF itself, which carries no addresses/descriptions - see README caveat). Source URL for each such confirmation is given in 'flag_basis'.
origin_flag_legend.LIKELY INDIAN-DOMESTIC (unconfirmed): Default when no foreign signal was found. NOT independently verified against a company registry - many of these could still turn out to be foreign JVs (see README caveats on 'IKN', 'Intensiv-Filter Himenviro', 'Larvij India', 'Elektromag - Joest Vibration') that were deliberately left unconfirmed rather than guessed.
